name: Pengendalian Api Berbasis Kearifan Lokal
description: Mengakui aturan penyiapan lahan berkelompok: musyawarah, sekat bakar, larangan musim kemarau dan di gambut dalam, serta tanggung jawab adat bila api menjalar. Didukung pendampingan dan peralatan. Petani tetap bisa berladang; hasilnya bergantung pada kepercayaan dan kepatuhan masyarakat.

provenance.note: Game policy option derived from a documented practice (CULT-0001) and the later Pergub Kalteng 27/2019 rules. Magnitudes are uncalibrated design values.

effects.label: Pengakuan aturan adat meningkatkan kepercayaan masyarakat setempat
Pencegahan kebakaran naik bertahap (~24 poin bila kepercayaan normal); lebih lemah bila kepercayaan rendah, lebih kuat bila tinggi

stakeholder_notes: tokoh adat (damang/mantir): peran pengawasan dan sanksi
daerah tetangga: risiko asap bila kepatuhan rendah
follow_up_case_triggers: CASE-0004-C opens if trust in Kalimantan Tengah falls (weak legitimacy)

cultural_basis.interpretation: Community fire governance (collective decision, firebreaks, seasonal limits, accountability) as a prevention mechanism whose effectiveness depends on social legitimacy (trust). Ritual elements are excluded.

game_design_notes: Cheapest prevention; slower and less certain; preserves livelihoods (no welfare cost). Effectiveness scales with trust (scale_by). Does not imply burning is safe on deep peat.
